title: JEB Little Creek Cove Marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: All season, Cove Marina provides patrons the opportunity to get out on the water and have a great time. Don’t have a boat? Not a problem. We have rental boats trailered and ready for launch, whether you’re looking to launch on-site or out in town! Our 19', Mckee Craft is available for rental during the boating season.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Cove Marina, located at 1101 Okinawa Road (Bldg. 1517), is the full-service marina aboard JEB Little Creek. We serve active duty, retired military, qualifying veterans and DOW personnel. For wet slip storage, we offer 84 concrete floating dock

hours: Hours December 1 through April 21 Monday 8 AM - 4:30 PM
